create_stop_words_set: create a frozenset of English stop words from scikit-learn's feature_extraction module
test_stop_words_membership: test whether a word is in scikit-learn's English stop words frozenset
summarize_stop_words: summarize the contents of scikit-learn's ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS frozenset
review_stop_words_source: review the source and origin of scikit-learn's ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS list
build_stop_word_filter: build a text filter that removes English stop words using scikit-learn's ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS frozenset
